settings.title: Our Grassroots Story
settings.description: I’m Ali Perry-Hatch, MPH: toxicologist + herbalist. I created Earth Harbor out of my treehouse kitchen & we got our start in farmers' markets. My biggest struggle with having a natural lifestyle was finding a comprehensive range of premium beauty products that was versatile and that lived up to my strict standards.
